title: Guided Diffusion for Trustworthy Synthetic Text Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27259v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid evolution of Large Language Models is fueled by massive datasets, yet this reliance poses severe privacy risks, as models can inadvertently memorize and even directly output sensitive training data. Synthetic text generation offers a promising solution to this challenge; however, existing methods struggle to reconcile rigorous privacy guarantees with high data utility. In this paper, we propose a new paradigm for private synthetic text generation: Guided Diffusion. Leveraging the unique steerability of Diffusion Language Models, we introduce novel sampling and re-masking procedures that actively guide the iterative denoising steps. These mechanisms steer the generative process to reconstruct fluent text that adheres to a target semantic distribution. translated_title: 面向可信合成文本生成的引导式扩散方法
translated_abstract: 大规模语言模型的快速发展得益于海量数据集的支撑，然而这种依赖带来了严重的隐私风险，因为模型可能无意中记住甚至直接输出敏感的训练数据。合成文本生成为这一挑战提供了一种有前景的解决方案；然而，现有方法难以在严格的隐私保证与高数据效用之间取得平衡。在本文中，我们提出了一种私有合成文本生成的新范式：引导式扩散。利用扩散语言模型独特的可引导性，我们引入了新颖的采样与重新掩码机制，主动引导迭代去噪步骤。这些机制引导生成过程重构出符合目标语义分布的流畅文本。我们证明了该框架与差分隐私（DP）天然兼容：一旦私有语料的语义嵌入得到保护，差分隐私保证便会随之延续。
tldr: 该论文提出了“引导式扩散”这一私有合成文本生成新范式，通过利用扩散语言模型的可引导性，以新颖的采样和重新掩码机制引导去噪过程，生成既符合差分隐私保证又兼具高数据效用的高质量合成文本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Guided Diffusion," a new paradigm for private synthetic text generation that leverages the steerability of Diffusion Language Models through novel sampling and re-masking procedures, enabling the generation of high-quality synthetic text that is naturally compatible with Differential Privacy guarantees while maintaining high data utility.
